voice.text: An ice cube, [pause] and a puddle. Are they both water? Tap your guess.

Water has <emphasis>three forms</emphasis>. [pause] Cold freezes it into ice. Warm melts it back. Very hot makes steam!
Ice is water, frozen. [pause] Steam is water, floating up as a gas. [pause] <emphasis>Same water, three forms!</emphasis>
And water always flows <emphasis>downhill</emphasis>. [pause] It never climbs up. It finds the low path.
Which form of water is this? And which way will it flow? Guess, then watch!
